title: Diagnostics
description: Reported faults, their observations and source history.
backToDay: Back to truck day and trip
exampleInfo: This module uses illustrative data until our telemetry server is connected.
realExplanation: Original diagnostic reports are read from each Karma truck’s Diagnostics section. Documented codes are decoded and other payloads remain inspectable. This history does not establish the current state of every ECU.
realHistoryHint: Real reports and read requests are in Karma → Trucks → More → Diagnostics. That screen selects its own bounded message ID window; illustrative Fleet assessments stay separate from these records.
observationPeriod: Loaded observation window (start included, end excluded)
periodHint: Dates use Europe/Sofia and select records with a report or status observation on those days. The end date is included. Status is the snapshot at the example clock, not a reconstruction for the selected day.
countsHint: Only the selected example records. Missing data does not mean a healthy vehicle.
resolvedHint: A reported status; repair or ECU clearing is not established.
emptyTitle: No fault records in this source snapshot
emptyDescription: Missing records do not establish that a vehicle is healthy.
logsDescription: Chronological observations, data availability and processing records.
logsPeriodHint: Dates select observations in Europe/Sofia, including rule evaluations whose input window overlaps the selected days. Evaluation rows retain their actual processing time; they are not GPS observations.
selectedOutsideFilters: This linked record is outside the current list filters. The filters are preserved.
riskDescription: Explainable early-warning examples, their input facts and missing evidence.
riskPeriodHint: Dates select evaluations whose input window overlaps the selected days in Europe/Sofia. Processing and retrieval times stay separate.
